title: Out of time
story: Last night's AlphaFold job, af2_screen, died before it finished. Its log is slurm-{{jid}}.out. Find out why, fix fold.sh, and resubmit it so it completes.

lesson.title: How --time works
lesson.why: Slurm stops a job when its time runs out, finished or not, so the next person gets the GPU. Shorter limits can also start sooner.
lesson.without: Too short a limit and the job ends with state TIMEOUT and "DUE TO TIME LIMIT" in its log. Leave it out and you get the default (1 hour here).

files.~/{{project}}/slurm-{{jid}}.out:
Running AlphaFold 2.3.2

Predicting design_002

tasks.text: Fix fold.sh and get af2_screen to complete

hints: The log's last line says why it stopped. `--time` in fold.sh is HH:MM:SS.
Give it more time, for example `#SBATCH --time=04:00:00`, then `sbatch fold.sh`.
